title: Jim Semivan told Ryan Bledsoe the family may be hybrids
summary: Jason Samosa tells of Jim Semivan told Ryan Bledsoe the family may be hybrids, about an unknown time at an unknown place, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Semivan purportedly told him, "You know, we think you're hybrids. The reason you're having these experiences is because you may have more non-human DNA

plain: A man named Jason Samosa, speaking on a podcast, says that Jim Semivan told Ryan Bledsoe, whose family reports strange experiences, that they might be hybrids. Samosa says Semivan reportedly told him the family was having these experiences because they may carry more non-human DNA, which, if true, would mean some people are partly descended from beings that are not human.
